title: History, Calendars, Timelines, Chronicles & Reality Explorer
objective: Deliver visibility-safe multi-scale history, governed calendar projection, timeline/chronicle exploration, divergence comparison and map/Scene time views over canonical MIB-11 Multiverse/Branch/Reality/Timeline/Era/Event and calendar/time owners without duplicating World truth.

bounded_contract.canonical_history_contract: MIB-11 Multiverse, Branch, Reality, Timeline, Era and Event identities plus their owning World/Reality/Event state remain canonical. WCI-02 may order, compare and project stable references but cannot mint a second World/Reality/Event/history ledger or rewrite canonical chronology.
bounded_contract.calendar_contract: Custom calendars are consumed only through governed calendar/time owner references and explicit source provenance. WCI-02 may render, compare or translate governed calendar labels when a supported relation exists, but cannot invent canonical conversion rules, epoch truth, elapsed-time truth or automatic calendar authority.
bounded_contract.chronicle_contract: History and chronicle views are derived ordered projections over authorized stable Event/Era/Timeline/Reality/Branch references. Prior history remains preserved; presentation order or filters do not erase owner history or turn a summary into canonical state.
bounded_contract.divergence_contract: Reality/timeline divergence comparison operates over stable shared and divergent references, preserves branch/reality identity, and cannot silently merge, reconcile or mutate divergent canonical owners.
bounded_contract.map_scene_time_contract: MAI, ISE and SSA map/Scene/spatial references may project authorized time/history state. Pixel position, camera/view state, map variant, Scene presentation or visual alignment cannot become canonical historical truth.
bounded_contract.visibility_contract: Authorization and visibility filtering precede counts, comparisons, summaries, chronology, reader/GM projections, map/Scene time views and AI context; hidden/GM/private history and protected cardinality cannot leak through aggregate output.
bounded_contract.accessibility_contract: Consequential chronology, calendar, divergence and map/Scene time information requires accessible nonvisual summaries/equivalents; the visual timeline or map is not exclusive truth.
bounded_contract.determinism_contract: Equivalent authorized inputs produce stable ordering, divergence sets and deterministic projection/receipt output independent of view or platform; wall-clock timing is not semantic truth.
bounded_contract.persistence_decision: No durable WCI-02 persistence is required for this tranche; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
bounded_contract.successor_boundary: WCI-03+, KFR-01+, public/community publishing, paid provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.

acceptance_contract: Test-first RED proves the bounded WCI-02 history/calendar/timeline/chronicle/reality-explorer contract and panel do not exist before production implementation.
One history explorer projection orders authorized Event/Era history across stable Multiverse/Branch/Reality/Timeline references without creating a parallel canonical history ledger.
Governed calendar references retain source provenance; unsupported or unresolved conversion remains explicit rather than inferred.
Divergence comparison preserves branch/reality identity and reports shared/divergent authorized references without merging or mutating canonical truth.
MAI/ISE/SSA map and Scene time views consume stable references while visual position/view state remain noncanonical presentation.
Hidden/GM/private history and protected cardinality are filtered before counts, comparisons, summaries, reader/GM projection and AI context.
Consequential history/calendar/divergence results have accessible nonvisual equivalents and deterministic ordering/receipts.
No canonical owner mutation, durable WCI-02 persistence, migration 0022, public publishing, provider activation or WCI-03 ownership is introduced.
Final validation uses exactly one WCI-02 current-family profile, self-hosted Linux, self-hosted Windows and deterministic comparator with zero historical predecessor fanout.
preserved_boundaries: WCI-01 remains completed_verified with retired implementation authority.
MIB-11 Multiverse/Branch/Reality/Timeline/Era/Event plus calendar/time, World/Reality and Event owner authorities remain canonical.
MAI, ISE and SSA remain projection inputs rather than duplicate history owners.
Hidden/GM/private historical state is filtered before aggregate or AI-context projection.
No second World/Reality/Event/history/calendar ledger or automatic canon mutation is authorized.
No durable WCI-02 ledger or migration 0022 is introduced.
WCI-03+, KFR-01+, public/community publishing, paid provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
next_action: Validate and merge this exact AIOC governed-start candidate; then create the bounded application branch from exact app main and execute WCI-02 test-first through final cross-platform proof, application merge and same-turn closeout/WCI-03 selection if no genuine blocker survives.
